seller.legalName: 上海示例出口有限公司

adjustment.enUS: The price is fixed and not subject to adjustment.

namedPlace.zhCN: 新加坡樟宜航空货运中心

insurance.zhCN: 卖方按CIP约定投保并提供保险凭证
insurance.enUS: The Seller shall procure insurance required by CIP and provide evidence of cover.

inspection.zhCN: 买方在到货后十日内检验数量和外观
inspection.enUS: The Buyer shall inspect quantity and apparent condition within ten days after arrival.

claimsPeriod.zhCN: 质量索赔应在发现后五日内书面提出并附证据
claimsPeriod.enUS: Quality claims shall be made in writing with evidence within five days after discovery.

titleTransfer.zhCN: 全部价款到账时所有权转移
titleTransfer.enUS: Title passes upon receipt of the full price.

riskTransfer.zhCN: 风险按约定的CIP规则转移
riskTransfer.enUS: Risk passes in accordance with the agreed CIP rule.

terms.zhCN: 装运前开立不可撤销信用证
terms.enUS: An irrevocable letter of credit shall be issued before shipment.

letterOfCreditTerms.zhCN: 信用证应允许分批议付并于装运后21日有效
letterOfCreditTerms.enUS: The credit shall permit partial drawings and remain valid for 21 days after shipment.

bankCharges.zhCN: 开证行费用由买方承担，卖方银行费用由卖方承担
bankCharges.enUS: Issuing-bank charges are for the Buyer; the Seller bears its bank charges.

packaging.zhCN: 适合国际空运的防潮包装
packaging.enUS: Moisture-resistant packaging suitable for international air transport.

shippingMarks.enUS: Shipping marks shall follow the Buyer's written instructions.

intellectualProperty.zhCN: 各方保留其原有知识产权
intellectualProperty.enUS: Each party retains its background intellectual property.

sanctionsAndExportControlAcknowledgement.zhCN: 双方自行核验并遵守适用于自身交易行为的制裁与出口管制要求
sanctionsAndExportControlAcknowledgement.enUS: Each party shall verify and comply with sanctions and export-control requirements applicable to its conduct.

forceMajeureAndHardship.zhCN: 受影响方及时通知并采取合理减损措施
forceMajeureAndHardship.enUS: The affected party shall give prompt notice and take reasonable mitigation measures.

breachRemedies.zhCN: 违约方赔偿可证明的直接损失
breachRemedies.enUS: The breaching party shall compensate proven direct losses.

governingLaw.zhCN: 除CISG调整事项外适用新加坡法律
governingLaw.enUS: Singapore law applies to matters not governed by the CISG.

forum.zhCN: 新加坡国际仲裁中心，仲裁地新加坡
forum.enUS: Singapore International Arbitration Centre, seat Singapore.

notices.zhCN: 通知发送至合同所列电子邮箱并以送达回执为准
notices.enUS: Notices shall be sent to the stated email addresses and evidenced by delivery receipt.
